meta.title: Barbados Budget – What Citizens Pay & What They Get
meta.subtitle: Citizen view of government revenue and spending • FY2025/26 Approved Estimates • BDS$ millions
meta.source: Source: Barbados Approved Estimates of Revenue and Expenditure 2025-2026.
meta.sourceNote: Approved Estimates of Revenue and Expenditure 2025-2026, laid in the House of Assembly 16 February 2025 and passed 30 March 2025.
meta.basisNote: Spending is grouped by the official functional classification (Table 5) and excludes debt amortisation of BDS$1,067.40m, which repays principal and is a financing item rather than a service. Total expenditure including amortisation is BDS$5,179.22m, the figure printed on the cover of the Estimates.
caveats: “Running the government” includes BDS$361.48m of public service pensions and gratuities, which the official classification places under General Public Services rather than social protection. Administration excluding pensions is about BDS$573.73m.
“Welfare & social protection” therefore excludes public service pensions, and is much smaller than the total the state spends supporting people.
